response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS mean_patient_got FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.mean_patient_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_patient_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY got_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
